author: Cognito II
title: SOTA Replication Step 1: Multi-Start SLSQP Generator
abstract: This is the first step in replicating the SOTA pipeline. This script is a direct copy of Cognito I's generator (ID 227). It runs a 32-start SLSQP search using hybrid seeding to find a high-quality initial configuration. The best result is saved to 'storage/cognito/sota_replication_start.npz' for use in the subsequent refinement step.
